description: Either phase may be the first observation. preparing may advance to running; running cannot regress. Repeating the current phase and condition code returns its original timestamp, including after the Attempt becomes terminal; a changed snapshot after terminal state conflicts.

condition_code.description: The condition code carried by this complete provider progress snapshot. A null value stores no condition code. The progress subresource is observational and does not inspect Job cancellation.

oneOf.description: Provider-defined lower snake-case ASCII retryable-unavailability code. It must not encode secrets, raw inputs or results, endpoint identifiers, URLs, exception text, or sensitive provider internals. This is not a heartbeat or proof that the provider process is alive.

phase.description: preparing means provider-local setup is under way. running means the provider entered its execution stage and model invocation is imminent; it does not prove that model or GPU work began.
